components: target: the van body including wheels, mirrors, number plate
attachment: roof rack with the ladder and the long rod bundle overhanging the windscreen
cast shadow on the pavement under and to the right-front of the van
van rear light at the left edge
occluded van areas behind the parked bicycles/moped (the overlapping bike and moped parts are inside the mask)

margin: ~30-35 px at 2048 px width (about one band + a few px) around the van; ~25 px around the soft shadow; reduced to ~24 px under the house-number plates and to ~18 px at the graffiti tag and red sticker that touch the top of the roof load
rationale: A removal: the van outline plus its roof load and the long shadow it casts to the right-front, with roughly a full feather band of margin so no silhouette ghosts through, cut back only beside the doorbell panel on the left and where lettering sits right above the roof load (house numbers 6 and 4 kept fully outside; the street-name sign, no-entry sign and plate, house number 2, door notice and TAKI 88 tag are well outside). Ambiguous: the parked bicycles and moped stand in front of the van's rear-lower quarter and cannot be cut out without leaving van visible through spokes and gaps, so their overlapping parts are inside the mask (parts beyond the van stay outside); and a graffiti tag and red sticker touch the top of the rods, so I leaned to the target with an ~18 px margin there, putting their bottom ~18 px in the low-alpha outer ramp while the rod tops still get only partial alpha.
